---
title: "Module 2: Functional Programming & Parallelism"
---

## Overview

Big data frameworks such as Apache Spark are built on functional programming, because functional code is easy to parallelise. This module covers the functional programming basics you need in Python, then uses the built-in `multiprocessing` library to speed up CPU-bound and I/O-bound work.
